detailed_description:
The target video is rendered in a polished 3D CG donghua style with cinematic lighting, volumetric mist, and sharp xianxia ranged-combat choreography. Subject 1's cyan glow and Subject 2's white glow stay visually distinct in every shot. There is no dialogue. The two fighters never close the distance between them; every attack is a projectile, a spell, or an artifact strike crossing the open courtyard, and each shot flows without a pause into the next exchange.

[Shot 1] A medium establishing shot frames <Subject 3>, the ruined forest-courtyard: a massive already-broken stone torii gate stands at center beneath a towering rocky cliff, twin waterfalls thunder down the left and right walls, gnarled roots hang above, cracked stone paving stretches across the foreground. Cool silver mist drifts low; soft bluish backlight filters down. A silver-white blur slashes in from the right — <Subject 2> 银月, the young woman with long silver-white hair, large fluffy white fox ears, pale skin, white-and-silver filigreed armor with red cord and a long white fur stole — and she halts in a slide on the right side of the courtyard, white energy already coiling around her raised hand. The camera trucks left with medium amplitude at normal speed, revealing <Subject 1> 梅凝, the young woman with long dark hair and a silver-grey silk slip, standing at the far left end of the courtyard beyond the torii gate, a cyan glow kindling around her fingers. The two women settle at opposite ends of the open ground, facing each other across the full length of the courtyard.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up on 银月 as she flicks her wrist and casts three white spirit-bolts in quick succession, each bolt shrieking away across the courtyard leaving a silvery streak. The camera tracks forward with medium amplitude at fast speed, riding behind the bolts as they streak toward 梅凝 at the far end, the torii gate flashing past in the foreground; 梅凝 raises her hand into frame as the bolts close in.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot on 梅凝: three cyan flying-swords rise from behind her shoulders and lance forward, intercepting the three bolts in mid-air — the collisions burst in rapid cyan-white flashes one after another with no gap, shattered light raining as drifting motes. In the same flowing motion she sweeps both arms and sends two of the flying-swords arcing wide around the torii gate toward 银月; the camera whips right with large amplitude at fast speed, following the swords' curved flight across the courtyard.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a close-up on 银月 as she shakes a silver-bell artifact (银铃法宝); a deep chime rings out and an expanding white sound-ring pulses outward, shattering both incoming flying-swords into cyan motes. The camera pulls back with small amplitude at fast speed as the residual ring washes across the courtyard, and 梅凝 sweeps her arms into frame, unfurling a cyan spirit-banner (青灵幡) that blooms into a vertical barrier and drinks the rest of the ring with a taut fabric crack, the cyan cloth snapping full.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot as 梅凝 stamps her foot and casts a talisman array (符箓阵); the camera trucks right with large amplitude at fast speed across the courtyard as glowing cyan runes flare open on the paving directly beneath 银月 and erupt upward — she leaps clear in a spinning backflip, talisman light bursting at her heels, and as she lands she snaps a white energy chain (白灵链) whip-fast across the courtyard; the chain rakes past 梅凝, who leans aside, and gouges a furrow through the cracked tiles behind her in a spray of stone chips.

[Shot 6] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a symmetrical medium shot framing both ends of the courtyard: 梅凝 on the left and 银月 on the right both form hand-seals and fire — a cyan beam and a white beam streak out simultaneously and collide mid-air in front of the torii gate, the impact point ballooning into a churning cyan-white sphere of light. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed toward the locked beams as sparks and motes spray off the collision.

[Shot 7] At 00:12.000, the white beam grinds the cyan one back and 梅凝 twists aside, letting the white beam hammer the paving behind her — the ground erupts in a crater blast of dust and tile shards. Without pausing she retaliates with a condensed cyan lance (青灵矛) flung from her palm; the camera whips right with large amplitude at fast speed, chasing the lance across the courtyard.

[Shot 8] At 00:14.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot on 银月 as she throws up a white energy shield (白灵盾); the cyan lance strikes it and the shield shatters into glassy white fragments, the impact staggering her half a step back. Riding the same momentum she hurls a white spirit-lance (白灵枪) of her own straight back across the courtyard; the camera whips left with large amplitude at fast speed after it.

[Shot 9] At 00:16.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot on 梅凝 as a cyan grand-sword (青灵巨剑) condenses out of light above her and meets the incoming white spirit-lance head-on in mid-air. The collision detonates: a vertical light column erupts skyward, a cyan-white shockwave ring rolls outward across the courtyard, nearby hanging roots are severed and flung out in splintered wood and dust, and the already-broken torii gate shudders hard, fracture lines widening and stone flakes shearing off, though it stays upright. The camera shakes slightly once with the blast, dust washing across the frame.

[Shot 10] At 00:18.000, the camera pulls back with small amplitude at slow speed as the dust thins: 梅凝 stands at the left end of the courtyard, breathing hard, motes of cyan light still drifting off her raised hand; 银月 stands at the right end, her white fur stole singed and dusted with grey, one arm lower than the other. Sparks and fading motes still drift between them across the cratered ground, the torii gate still standing as a fractured arch behind them, the twin waterfalls still falling. Both women remain locked in a standoff across the open ground, eyes fixed on each other. The video ends on this dynamic, still-alive image — explicitly not a stylized color-shift freeze-frame.

overall_soundscape:
Twin waterfalls roar continuously in the background. Each cast is followed by a sharp shriek of a projectile crossing the courtyard, and each interception detonates in a bright glassy high-frequency burst. The silver-bell artifact emits a deep resonant chime; the cyan spirit-banner snaps taut with a fabric crack; the talisman array erupts with a sharp crackling pop; the white energy chain hisses whip-fast through the air. The locked beams grind with a sustained crackling roar until they burst, and the final mid-air collision lands a deep concussive boom under a high ring, followed by falling stone, snapping roots, and the long hiss of settling dust — all sounds chaining from one exchange into the next without a beat of silence.
